name: dns-constraint-with-underscore-invalid
description: permittedSubtrees DNS _acme-challenge.example.com contains an underscore, which is not a preferred-name-syntax label character. Some factories (Botan's, e.g.) reject such constraint strings outright.
notes: Some validators (notably OpenSSL/Go) accept underscore-bearing labels in DNS constraints; the strict-RFC view rejects.
